description: NHFLOW semi-implicit with wave breaking: Ting & Kirby spilling breaker, coarse (600 cells x 4 layers, dx 0.05 m, dt 0.02 s, theta 1/2, A 510 11, A 520 2, NH wetting-drying A 537 1), Kennedy viscosity with the Barthelemy seed (A 550 4). The breaking viscosity in the column operator and in the sub-stepped horizontal diffusion.
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI::vb_layer / col_nu (breaking viscosity of the layers)
nhflow_momentum_SI::si_end_cells (breaking zones and viscosity at the end of the step)
